analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 44 to 53.3, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram improved from -1.1778 to 1.3196, indicating bullish expansion after a golden cross. Trading volume is subdued at 0.70x the 5-day average, but improving indicators offset this weakness.
